That's within a round.

But here's a case: round r1 occupies v's only capacity slot; round r2's PING arrives at v → capacity_drops → no entry → v never learns about r2's parent. Then r2's parent u never gets an ACK for that edge → u times out ✓. That's what my implementation does ✓.

cd /work && python3 - << 'PY'
import json, subprocess, sys, time
MAIN="/work/submission/main.py"
def run(data, timeout=130):
    t=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",MAIN],input=data,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=timeout)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout[:200], p.stderr[:300], time.time()-t

cases = {}
cases["deep nested arrays"] = b"["*200000 + b"]"*200000
cases["deep nested objects"] = (b'{"a":'*100000 + b'1' + b'}'*100000)
cases["huge int"] = json.dumps({"version":1,"n":10**100,"capacity":[],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}).encode()
cases["huge int launch"] = json.dumps({"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[{"launch_us":10**5000,"timeout_us":1,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}).encode()
cases["long string"] = json.dumps({"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"*2000000}],"rounds":[]}).encode()
cases["many dup keys"] = b'{"version":1,"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}'
cases["null bytes"] = b'{"version":1,\x00"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}'
cases["bom"] = b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}'
cases["empty"] = b""
cases["utf16"] = json.dumps({"version":1,"n":2,"capacity":[1,1],"edges":[],"rounds":[]}).encode("utf-16")
for name, data in cases.items():
    rc, out, err, dt = run(data)
    print("%-22s len=%-9d rc=%d %.2fs out=%r err=%r" % (name, len(data), rc, dt, out[:90], err[:120]))
